## dependency_form
Hop mark from the blind answer: one hop, state-derived, not pre-solved. Whole-corpus scan for this task's policies:
- Prerequisite sentence verbatim on the blocked side only; no action restatement, no route, no chain, no mirrored title — PASS on the edge itself.
- **K5** `cancellation_credit_short_rate_c52dd777` (computation document), "Records read": "Within the term premium booked, the tier's annual loss-of-use charge forms part of the term premium item." The baseline formula never separates the loss-of-use charge; the split exists only for the lou_return and claim_share factors. Computation document naming a factor quantity (hints a variation).
- **K6** `policy_fee_return_on_cancellation_06ee3a0c` (factor of sale_cancellation), paragraph "Installment fees": restates the whole overdue-installment-fee give-back ladder of homeflood_ext_closing_payment ("given back with the closing payment that settles the account: in full when … in full when … property sold … half when … replaced coverage …"). A factor document of one problem carrying another problem's factor ladder in a second document and pointing at the other problem's payment. Source origin: the sale_cancellation rule embeds the same text (see S5); the C5 retirement already has a bearing document (`insured_cancellation_and_refund_terms_414d4c76`), so the factor-document carriage is the rendering's.
- **K7** (low) `loss_of_use_charge_return_a906136c`: "That charge is returned on the same earning basis as the rest of the term premium" and the illustration "cancelled on the pro rata basis with 0.4 of the term remaining" name the earning_basis factor and one of its tiers inside another factor's document.
